text:
```yaml
name: Claude Review Automation

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Code Action
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "/review-pr|/review-pr-ci|/review-issue"
          base_branch: "main"
          branch_prefix: "claude-review"
          branch_name_template: "review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
          allowed_bots: ""
          allowed_non_write_users: ".*"
          include_comments_by_actor: "true"
          exclude_comments_by_actor: ""
          prompt: ""
          settings: ""
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          anthropic_federation_rule_id: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID }}
```
